S.label: Periods of Economic Life
S.description: Number of model periods an agent lives. With annual periods, S=80 means agents live 80 years of economic life.

starting_age.label: Starting Age
starting_age.description: Age at which agents enter the model economy and begin making economic decisions.

ending_age.label: Ending Age
ending_age.description: Maximum age of agents in the model. Must equal starting_age + S.

lambdas.label: Ability Type Fractions
lambdas.description: Population fraction by ability type (J types). Values must sum to 1.0. E.g., [0.6, 0.3, 0.1] means 60% low, 30% mid, 10% high ability.

beta_annual.label: Annual Discount Factor
beta_annual.description: Annual time preference discount factor. 0.96 means agents discount future utility by 4% per year. Lower values = more impatient.

sigma.label: Risk Aversion
sigma.description: Coefficient of relative risk aversion (CRRA). Higher values mean agents are more risk-averse and prefer smoother consumption.

frisch.label: Frisch Elasticity
frisch.description: Frisch elasticity of labor supply. Higher values mean labor supply is more responsive to wage changes.

ltilde.label: Time Endowment
ltilde.description: Total time endowment per period, normalized to 1.0. Agents allocate this between labor and leisure.

gamma.label: Capital Share
gamma.description: Capital share of output in the Cobb-Douglas production function. 0.40 means 40% of output goes to capital owners.

gamma_g.label: Public Capital Share
gamma_g.description: Share of output attributable to public (government) capital. 0 means no public capital in production.

delta_annual.label: Depreciation Rate
delta_annual.description: Annual rate at which physical capital depreciates. 0.05 = 5% depreciation per year.

epsilon.label: Elasticity of Substitution
epsilon.description: Elasticity of substitution between capital and labor. 1.0 = Cobb-Douglas (unit elasticity).

Z.label: Total Factor Productivity
Z.description: Total factor productivity (TFP) level. Higher Z means the economy produces more output from the same inputs.

alpha_G.label: Gov Spending / GDP
alpha_G.description: Share of GDP the government spends on goods and services. 0.15 = 15% of GDP.

alpha_T.label: Transfers / GDP
alpha_T.description: Share of GDP distributed as government transfers to households. 0.12 = 12% of GDP.

alpha_I.label: Infrastructure Investment / GDP
alpha_I.description: Share of GDP spent on public infrastructure investment. 0.02 = 2% of GDP.

tG1.label: Gov Spending Adjust Start
tG1.description: Year at which government spending begins adjusting toward its target level.

tG2.label: Gov Spending Adjust End
tG2.description: Year by which government spending reaches its target level.

debt_ratio_ss.label: Steady-State Debt/GDP
debt_ratio_ss.description: Target debt-to-GDP ratio in the long-run steady state. 1.20 = debt is 120% of GDP.

initial_debt_ratio.label: Initial Debt/GDP
initial_debt_ratio.description: Initial debt-to-GDP ratio at the start of the simulation. 0.59 = debt is 59% of GDP.

cit_rate.label: Corporate Income Tax Rate
cit_rate.description: Statutory corporate income tax rate. 0.21 = 21% corporate tax rate.

tau_c.label: Consumption Tax Rate (VAT)
tau_c.description: Consumption tax / VAT rate applied to all consumption. 0 = no consumption tax.

tau_payroll.label: Payroll Tax Rate
tau_payroll.description: Tax rate on labor income for payroll/social security. 0 = no payroll tax.

tau_bq.label: Bequest/Estate Tax Rate
tau_bq.description: Tax rate on bequests (inheritances). 0 = no estate tax.

h_wealth.label: Wealth Tax Rate
h_wealth.description: Rate parameter for the wealth tax function. Higher values = higher effective wealth tax.

m_wealth.label: Wealth Tax Midpoint
m_wealth.description: Midpoint parameter for the wealth tax function. Determines the wealth level at which the tax is half its maximum rate.

p_wealth.label: Wealth Tax Scale
p_wealth.description: Scale parameter for the wealth tax function. Controls how quickly the tax rate rises with wealth.

world_int_rate_annual.label: World Interest Rate
world_int_rate_annual.description: Annual world interest rate for the small open economy. 0.04 = 4% annual rate.

initial_foreign_debt_ratio.label: Initial Foreign Debt / GDP
initial_foreign_debt_ratio.description: Initial ratio of foreign-held debt to GDP. 0 = no foreign debt initially.

zeta_D.label: Domestic Debt Share
zeta_D.description: Share of new government debt held by domestic investors. 0.4 = 40% held domestically.

zeta_K.label: Domestic Capital Share
zeta_K.description: Share of new capital held by domestic investors. 0.2 = 20% of capital is domestically owned.

ubi_nom_017.label: UBI Ages 0–17
ubi_nom_017.description: Annual nominal UBI payment for ages 0 to 17. 0 = no UBI for this age group.

ubi_nom_1864.label: UBI Ages 18–64
ubi_nom_1864.description: Annual nominal UBI payment for ages 18 to 64. 0 = no UBI for this age group.

ubi_nom_65p.label: UBI Ages 65+
ubi_nom_65p.description: Annual nominal UBI payment for ages 65 and older. 0 = no UBI for this age group.

ubi_nom_max.label: Max UBI per Household
ubi_nom_max.description: Maximum total UBI payment per household. 0 = no cap on household UBI.
